bullets: Added support for prepaid annual subscriptions, modeling a one-time annual checkout and tracking when another pay-once year can be purchased to extend the plan.
Simplified the streak perk text to state that the daily Freebucks bonus is granted every Pacific day, matching the streak clock that already uses Pacific time.
Changed the landing screen to name the unreachable session host on network timeout and connectivity failures rather than echoing raw error messages.
Fixed a regression where the Imprezia ad provider was still routable through credentials; it is now fully retired and only first-party, house, and gravity providers are allowed.
Updated the GLM 5.3 Flash price ceiling to $0.14 prompt and $0.45 completion to match re-priced provider benchmarks.
Changed the ban-exempt user constant to narrow its scope so the exemption no longer waives enforcement itself, only account downgrade and related flags.
Added a Supabase CPC format experiment with a V3 invitation card, introducing a new agentic click-CTA billing action.
Consolidated email hashing for Meta and paid-social CAPl senders into a single normalization utility.
Simplified paid-social attribution for X by normalizing emails and conditionally including hashed email only for the x platform.
Added an on-demand SDK history compaction API that lets callers trigger compaction immediately and returns previous and next token totals.
Removed the freebucks picker notice text and dependency from the landing screen since prices are now shown inline per row.
